decisions.quote:
Our ﬁndings were mostly consistent with those of the original study (see details below), except that we did not ﬁnd that gender moderated the
indirect effects of company diversity on interest in working for the company via the perception of the company’s sincere interest in increasing

gender diversity.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly frame their findings as only partly supporting the original study (13 of 17 key findings replicated), contrasting their null result for gender moderation of the indirect effect on company interest—one of the two main conditional process models tested—and the lack of difference between counterfeit diversity and authentic non-diversity with the original Study 3 findings.
